extracted.summary: A partner at Netherby Solicitors LLP asks for £29,000 to fund a client's financial remedy case at the Family Court at Leeds, where the only asset is flat equity of about £13,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would need the date of the next hearing and the expected timetable to final hearing, confirmation of the current asset and liability position (including any valuation and mortgage statement for the flat), and details of the costs already incurred and estimated to final hearing. It would also help to have your client's details and confirmation of any other funding sources considered. Once we have that information a member of the team will come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or indication of funding.
